biotools.summary: MitoTouch is a computerized method for analyzing mitochondrial shape and network architecture from confocal fluorescence images, providing more than thirty features to quantify changes in mitochondrial organization. It enables the identification of subtle differences in morphology and has potential applications in cell biology, medicine, and environmental toxicology.
